sourceLabel: City of Orange actions on an SB 9 urban lot split application filed 2025-10-08, as described in HCD's letter to the City of Orange (2026-05-05), pp. 1-2. HCD quotes no city code; these are HCD's descriptions. Not the city's current form.

items.text: The City declined to accept and process an SB 9 urban lot split application submitted on 2025-10-08, because it would create a parcel with only an ADU and no primary dwelling (as described by HCD).
The City indicated that converting the ADU into a primary dwelling "cannot be done because the City code does not currently provide a process for approving such a conversion" (as described by HCD).
